files.description: Hospital admissions (260 rows): admission_id (whole number), age (years, whole number; about 5% empty), ward (cardiology, oncology, maternity, orthopedics or neurology; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), stay_days (whole number; about 3% empty), charge (two decimals; about 5% empty).

task_text: Stays longer than 14 days are billed as 14 days. Apply that cap to stay_days and then give the average billed stay per ward (ward names in lower case without extra spaces), rounded to two decimals; missing stays are ignored. `result` should be a Series indexed by ward.
intended_computation: Cap stay_days at 14, clean ward (5 wards) and return the mean capped stay per ward (missing stays skipped), rounded to 2 decimals; every value lies between 0 and 14.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the column-then-mask assignment does not reach the table, so stays are not capped

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
